items.title: Oil Heads for Weekly Gains on Iran War Risks
items.content: <article>Oil headed for its biggest weekly gain since July as renewed US-Iran hostilities heightened concerns about prolonged disruptions to energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz. Bloomberg's Onur Ant has the latest. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Maniatis: Hormuz Escalation Risk Has Eased
items.content:
<article>Dimitris Maniatis, CEO of Marisks, says the latest intelligence assessment has reduced expectations of a near-term escalation in the Strait of Hormuz, after earlier analysis pointed to heightened risk. He says 25 ships transited the southern corridor under U.S. military guidance the previous day and vessel movements are continuing. Maniatis also says attractive earnings are drawing shipowners back to the route, while crews remain cautious but are willing to transit with bonuses, security support and proper risk assessments. He speaks with Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East and Africa.
 (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: South Africa’s IDC to Sell Its Stake in Namibian Uranium Mine
items.author: Arijit Ghosh
items.content: <article>South Africa’s Industrial Development Corp. plans to sell its stake in a Namibian uranium project because the mine’s backers include Iranian and Russian entities.</article>

items.title: World Bank’s Mishra Pushes Back on Doubts Over India Growth
items.author: Ruchi Bhatia
items.content: <article>A range of high-frequency indicators show India’s economy is gaining momentum, said World Bank Executive Director Neelkanth Mishra, pushing back against skepticism over whether strong headline growth reflects conditions on the ground.</article>

items.title: Chip Suppliers Bullish on AI Buildout
items.content: <article>Chip suppliers at the annual SEMICON Taiwan event are bullish about the prospect of a continued AI buildout. Bloomberg's Chief North Asia Correspondent Stephen Engle reports from Taipei and explains how some firms are predicting the sector's current "super cycle" will last until 2030. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Wheat Edges Lower on Peace Hopes as Black Sea Attacks Continue
items.author: Hallie Gu
items.content: <article>Chicago wheat edged lower after the steepest drop in nearly three years even as prospects of a peace deal between Russia and Ukraine faded with continued fighting in the Black Sea region.</article>

items.title: World Bank's Mishra Pushes Back on India Growth Doubts
items.content: <article>A range of high-frequency indicators show India’s economy is gaining momentum, said World Bank Executive Director Neelkanth Mishra, pushing back against skepticism over GDP data, in an interview with Bloomberg's Haslinda Amin and Menaka Doshi. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: China Flash Memory Giant YMTC Takes Key Step Toward Marquee IPO
items.author: Bloomberg News
items.content: <article>China’s flash memory champion Yangtze Memory Technologies Co. has moved on to the next stage in the process toward an initial public offering, a sign that the nation’s next marquee listing is progressing apace despite earlier concerns about a potentially slower route.</article>

items.title: Ukraine Braces For Brutal Winter at Mercy of Russian Air Strikes
items.author: Kollen Post
items.content: <article>Ukraine’s shortage of Patriot missiles has left Kyiv with few options to protect its citizens during another winter of escalating Russian air strikes.</article>

items.title: Emerging Market Stocks, Currencies Rise as Fed Hike Bets Ease
items.author: Malavika Kaur Makol
items.content: <article>Emerging market stocks and currencies rose as investors pared bets on a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike this month, sending the dollar lower.</article>

items.title: Is the Chip Supercycle Here to Stay?
items.content: <article>Semiconductor industry executives share their insights with Bloomberg on the sidelines of the SEMICON Taiwan 2026 in Taipei, weighing in on the AI-driven chip supercycle and its sustainability. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: PNJ Taps Chairwoman’s Family for Loan After Diamond Scandal
items.author: Nguyen Kieu Giang
items.content: <article>Phu Nhuan Jewelry JSC, Vietnam’s largest listed jeweler known as PNJ, is securing a loan from the family of Chairwoman Cao Thi Ngoc Dung to rebuild its business after a national diamond-smuggling scandal battered the industry.</article>

items.title: Sharp Price Swings Prompt SEBI Review of India’s Closing Auction
items.author: Pratigya Vajpayee and Samie Modak
items.content: <article>Regulator may propose changes to the way settlement prices for equity derivatives contracts are calculated.</article>

items.title: Philippines Keeps Eye on Iran War as Inflation Barely Eases
items.author: Neil Jerome Morales and Ditas B Lopez
items.content: <article>The Philippine central bank said it’s “closely” monitoring the impact of the Middle East conflict and weather disturbances after inflation barely eased in August.</article>

items.title: Carry Trade Exodus Fuels Yen Gain Ahead of BOJ Rate Decision
items.author: David Finnerty and Ruth Carson
items.content: <article>A rush to unwind yen-funded carry trades helped send the currency to a one-month high against the dollar as traders ramped up bets on further Bank of Japan rate hikes.</article>

items.title: Malaysian August Palm Oil Exports Fell on Weak Indian Demand
items.author: Kanupriya Kapoor and Eko Listiyorini
items.content: <article>Malaysian palm oil exports likely fell last month on weaker-than-usual festival demand in major buyer India.</article>

items.title: Stocks Rise as Fed Hike Bets Ease, Dollar Steadies: Markets Wrap
items.author: Anand Krishnamoorthy and Abhishek Vishnoi
items.content: <article>Global stocks extended their advance as easing bets on a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike this month lifted sentiment. The dollar steadied after sliding to a four-month low, while the yen pared some of its two-day surge.</article>

items.title: India’s SEBI to Review Options Settlement Pricing After Closing Auction Chaos
items.author: Savio Shetty
items.content: <article>India’s markets regulator may propose changes to equity derivatives settlement pricing after feedback over sharp price swings triggered by the new closing-auction system.</article>

items.title: Saudi AI Firm Humain Explores $2.5 Billion Fund for Data Centers
items.author: Omar El Chmouri
items.content: <article>Artificial intelligence firm Humain is planning to raise an initial $2.5 billion from global and domestic investors for a fund to invest in data centers in Saudi Arabia, according to people familiar with the matter.</article>
